title: Vittoria Expands Their RideArmor Tires up to 700×42
content:
RideArmor expands with a new 700x42c size, bringing greater versatility to Vittoria’s most durable and puncture-resistant road tire.

Vittoria RideArmor 700×42 Quick Hits

  • Price: $89.99
  • Weight:​ 480 grams
  • Availability:​ Available at launch through Vittoria.com and Vittoria retailers

Built around one clear priority,​ reliability, RideArmor combines fast-rolling road performance with added protection for riders who want to keep moving across a wider range of conditions.

The new 42c size suits modern gravel and all-road bikes with clearance for higher-volume tires. It gives riders a fast-rolling road option with the added volume, durability and puncture protection that can make it equally useful for all-season riding, rough pavement and daily commuting.

For touring and bikepacking, the larger volume also adds comfort and support for long days in the saddle and routes that mix pavement with stretches of light gravel.

With sizes now ranging from 26mm to 42mm, RideArmor offers riders more options to match their bike, terrain and riding priorities.

Find out more at Vittoria.
